\section{Release Notes}
\label{\detokenize{topics/release_notes:release-notes}}\label{\detokenize{topics/release_notes::doc}}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{v1.01:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
First release

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{v1.02: Jan 22 2025}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cookies : Session expiration handled more gracefully and tells user to login again.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cloning improvements: Some rare occurrences cause the cloning to skip some parameters.

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
This is now ﬁxed and cleaner. Switching is also slightly faster.

\sphinxlineitem{v1.03: Jun 26 2025}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Performance improvements and DDA Panel support

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{v1.04: July 25 2025}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Release for replacement of ISATech with minor ﬁxes and related to 10MHz

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{v1.05: Oct 2 2025}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cleanup of Command Line Interface

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Supply Voltage is secondary side so it is DC not AC even if the supply type is AC

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{v1.06: Oct 14 2025}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Adding Ethernet Connection Alarm

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Adding IF switch status to Web and Command line

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{v1.07: Feb 24 2026}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
First phase release of SNMP v1/v2c:

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Support for Information, Alarm, Sensor and Redundancy

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{v1.08: Mar 03 2026}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
SNMP v2c: Allowing any network to access the SNMP agent.

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{v1.09: Mar 12 2026}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Fixing a conflicting redundant position of Antenna A and B going to spare.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
SNMP v2c: Updated MIB to support TX Configuration for iBUCs.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Controller’s 10MHz reference alarm is now default as Minor

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{v1.10: May 08 2026}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Fixing IF switch incorrect position when BUC A and BUC B are at fault one after the other.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Event log tab added

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Memory leak fixes related to SNMP long term running

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
SNMP v2c: Updated MIB to support Alarm Configuration

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Alarm configuration for TXI controller module

\end{itemize}

\end{description}
